lines.en: Are you hungry? It's time for lunch.
Yes, Grandma. I'm very hungry.
What do you want for lunch today?
I want noodles. We had rice this morning.
lines.ko: 국수 먹고 싶어요. 오늘 아침에 밥 먹었잖아요.

lines.en: Good idea. I will make noodle soup.
Can we have cheese too?
Of course. Cheese and meat go in the soup.
Thank you, Grandma. What is for dinner?
Yesterday we ate fish, so tonight is meat.
lines.ko: 어제는 생선을 먹었으니 오늘 밤은 고기예요.

lines.en: Great! I love every meal you make.
lines.ko: 좋아요! 할머니가 만드는 모든 식사가 좋아요.

lines.en: Hi! What food do you like best?
I like rice and soup. And you?
I love noodles. I ate noodles yesterday.
lines.ko: 저는 국수를 좋아해요. 어제도 국수를 먹었어요.

lines.en: Do you like cheese?
Yes, a little. I like meat more.
My son eats meat at every meal.
lines.ko: 제 아들은 매 식사마다 고기를 먹어요.

lines.en: Is he hungry all the time?
Yes! Dinner is his best time.
lines.ko: 네! 저녁 시간이 제일 좋은 시간이에요.

lines.en: Come to my house. I will make lunch tomorrow.
lines.ko: 우리 집에 오세요. 내일 점심을 만들게요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will bring some fruit.
